verdict: A very close rebuild where every block, icon and color is in place; the visible gaps are the featured-image card's corner radius (about 28 dp instead of 16) and web Roboto's tighter tracking, which shifts the wrapping and the extract's truncation. The structure is clean, named, flex-based HTML with a templated bottom navigation.

top_defects.what: corners at rounded-[28px] (~74 px at 2.625) instead of 16 dp (~42 px): the top corners are visibly rounder, and red corner wedges show on the heatmap

top_defects.where: body text (banner, module description, article extract)
top_defects.what: Roboto renders with tighter tracking than the Android reference. 'Content and resources selected by and about' ends ~11 px earlier, and the drift grows along each line, which makes up most of the heatmap's red text doubling
ellipsis lands after 'Cheltenham…' instead of 'Cheltenham Tr…' because of the narrower text
the card's lines sit 2-4 px higher than the reference (title, subtitle, divider, extract), and its rounded bottom corners show above the navigation bar where the reference is cut square by it
corner radius 12 px instead of 8 dp
the Community underline and 'EN' box sit 1-2 px off, and the nav icons, pill and badges sit ~2 px lower than in the reference
149 arbitrary values (colors such as #54595d and #202122 repeated, mt-[28.5px] and similar magic offsets) and no tokens; only the nav bar is templated
hacks: 'gap-[-1px] -space-x-[1px]', inline style for FILL, and the image placed at left-[-47.5px] with max-w-none instead of object-position

strengths: Every element of the reference is present at the right size and color: wordmark, tabs, EN button, banner with globe, featured image with veil, save/share buttons, red 'new' dots, and the pill on the Home tab
The app's own icons (home, bookmark, search, activity, menu, share, more) are used at 24 px with the right tints (#3366cc, #72777d, #202122)
Bottom navigation built once as a data-driven template with per-item pill, badge and label class; blocks named Header, Tabs row, Community banner, Featured article card, Article summary
